steps.text: Borrow two processor units from the pool. Storage units are not requested in this step. Retain the borrowed processor units until their specified return.
Return both of the two processor units held by this job to the pool. No storage units are acquired or returned by this step.
Now borrow one storage unit from the pool. The previously returned processor units stay returned; do not borrow them again.
Return the single storage unit to the pool, leaving this job with no units held. This is the final step.
Borrow two processor units from the pool and retain them while proceeding to the next step. No storage units are borrowed yet.
Retain the processor units already held and additionally borrow two storage units. There is no additional processor borrowing here.
Return the two processor units and the two storage units to the pool. This final return leaves no units held.
